title: Deterministic process-plan hash classification
goal: Remove time as an algorithm-authority signal while preserving exact V1/V2 hashes and fail-closed execution.

tasks.description: Introduce one structured payload-shape classifier shared conceptually by runtime mapping and migration tests.
Classify no-V2-shape rows as LegacyV1 regardless of CreatedAtUtc.
Classify complete valid V2 shape as HostCapabilitiesV2.
Classify partial, malformed or conflicting shapes as Unknown.
Keep LegacyV1 as NeedsRecompile with HostCapabilitiesWereNotSealed.
Add a corrective idempotent migration for databases that already applied AddProcessPlanHashVersioning.
Use PostgreSQL jsonb structure checks rather than LIKE and wall-clock cutoffs.
Prove existing V1 and V2 hash fixtures remain byte-for-byte stable.
